name: Cucumber

schedule.notes: Wait for soil 70 F. Cool soil rots seeds.
To 12 in apart along a trellis.
Compost or balanced fert as fruit sets.
Pick every 1 to 2 days — overripe fruit halts production.

harvest.cues: Pick slicers at 6 to 8 in; picklers at 3 to 4 in. Skin should be firm, glossy, deep green.
harvest.storageNotes: Fridge 1 week, away from tomatoes and bananas — ethylene yellows them fast.

varieties.name: Lemon
varieties.notes: Round, yellow when ready. Mild, tender skin. Whimsical and prolific.

notes: Trellis everything you can — saves space, runs straighter fruit, cuts disease pressure. Even mulch keeps fruit clean and slows mildew.
